object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Take a document with a heading and a requirement below it; the requirement has a rationale and an outgoing link. Give it a rules file of three rules, in this order: a heading forbids rationale; a requirement without outgoing links requires rationale; a requirement with outgoing links makes rationale optional. (a) Add a rationale to the heading and validate. (b) Starting again, remove the requirement's link and its rationale, and validate. Expected: (a) RULE_FORBIDDEN_PRESENT, from the first rule on the heading; (b) RULE_REQUIRED_MISSING, from the second rule on the requirement.
